categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in micro-nano metal powder materials, primarily engaged in the research, development, production and sales of carbonyl iron powder, atomized alloy powder, and related powder deep-processing products. The product portfolio includes carbonyl iron powder series, atomized alloy powder series, soft magnetic powder series, metal injection molding feedstock series, and microwave absorption material series.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in carbonyl synthesis and decomposition processes, water atomization, and gas atomization techniques. Key technologies include high-performance stainless steel binder systems, pressure-resistant high-impedance iron-silicon-chromium soft magnetic powder preparation, and novel high-frequency low-power-loss iron-silicon composite material preparation. The company is one of the few manufacturers capable of producing both carbonyl iron powder and atomized alloy powder.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include leading electronics component manufacturers (Taiwan Delta Electronics, Samsung Electronics), 3C product companies (VIVO, Jingyan Technology), international diamond tool enterprises (Husqvarna, Ehwa, Hilti), and automotive component manufacturers (Porite, Indo-MIM). Main end markets include consumer electronics, automotive electronics, diamond tools, 3D printing, and aerospace applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Ganzhou, Jiangxi Province. It has established sales networks covering mainland China, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, Europe, and Southeast Asia. The company exports to over 20 countries and regions globally, with a German subsidiary (YUELONG GmbH) serving the European market.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream segment of the powder metallurgy industry, producing micro-nano metal powder materials as fundamental raw materials for downstream applications. It supplies to manufacturers of powder metallurgy products, metal injection molding components, soft magnetic materials, and 3D printing materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing carbonyl iron powder innovation technology to reduce costs and expand market applications; (2) developing high-performance soft magnetic materials for 5G, AI computing, and automotive electronics; (3) expanding into emerging applications in new energy vehicles and aerospace; (4) strengthening product quality and brand influence through ESG practices; (5) promoting digital transformation and automation in manufacturing; (6) enhancing R&D capabilities through university-industry-research collaborations.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of customized metal powder products to downstream manufacturers. Revenue streams include: (1) direct sales of carbonyl iron powder and atomized alloy powder as base materials; (2) sales of deep-processed products (soft magnetic powder, MIM feedstock, microwave absorption materials); (3) technical services and customized product development. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In carbonyl iron powder, the company faces limited competition from global players including BASF (Germany), Sandviks Osprey (UK), and EPSON Atmix (Japan). The company holds a relatively clear competitive position in this segment. In atomized alloy powder, competition is more fragmented with multiple domestic and international competitors. The company is recognized as a leading domestic producer and holds the title of National Single Champion Demonstration Enterprise (2021) and National Specialized, Refined, Special, and Novel 'Little Giant' Enterprise (2019).
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of RMB 368.48 million (down 13.84% YoY) and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 79.88 million (down 19.15% YoY). Total assets reached RMB 875.61 million, with shareholders' equity of RMB 701.34 million. The company experienced revenue decline primarily due to reduced demand in consumer electronics and shift in customer purchasing patterns from high-end cobalt-chromium alloy powder to iron-based powder.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's competitive differentiation includes: (1) rapid product development capability—new alloy material development cycle of approximately one month versus six months to one year for overseas competitors; (2) comprehensive product portfolio offering one-stop solutions across multiple powder types; (3) advanced quality management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IATF 16949 certified); (4) strong technical service capabilities with application laboratories for 3C precision components, soft magnetic materials, and diamond tools; (5) established relationships with leading global customers; (6) commitment to innovation and ESG practices, including ISO 14021 environmental declaration verification.
